name: First shot
summary: A picket of the 8th Illinois Cavalry fires on the head of Archer's column on the Chambersburg Pike at Knoxlyn Road. The marker on the spot says 7:30; the Army's campaign history says about 7:00.

name: Buford forms
summary: Gamble and Devin form line of battle and Calef's guns go into battery on the pike.

name: Guns open
summary: Marye's battery opens from Herr Ridge while Archer's brigade halts on the pike.

name: Heth deploys
summary: Archer forms south of the pike and Davis north of it.
playback_text: Archer forms south of the pike and Davis north of it. The spreadsheet says 9:30; Bachelder's map says 9 a.m.

name: Across the run
summary: Both Confederate brigades cross Willoughby Run.

name: Infantry arrives
summary: Davis is in line against Cutler's brigade of the First Corps north of the pike, Meredith's brigade meets Archer at Willoughby Run, and the cavalry is relieved.

name: Railroad cut
summary: The 6th Wisconsin, 95th New York and 14th Brooklyn charge Davis's men in the unfinished railroad cut and take hundreds of prisoners. The map times the charge 10.30 a.m.; the Army's campaign history has the fight there end about noon.

name: Reynolds killed
summary: Reynolds is killed by a bullet as he sends the Iron Brigade into Herbst Woods, and Doubleday takes over the First Corps. No source read gives a firm time: it was moments after the brigade came up at about 10:15, and before the charge on the railroad cut; a modern timeline says 10:50.

name: Morning attack fails
summary: Heth's two brigades are driven back, Archer is a prisoner, and by about noon the firing dies down. The rest of the First Corps comes up.

name: Rodes on Oak Hill
summary: Rodes's division is in line on Oak Hill, north of the First Corps, as two divisions of the Eleventh Corps form north of the town.

name: Rodes attacks
summary: O'Neal attacks Oak Ridge alone and is thrown back; Iverson follows without skirmishers and is shot down from behind a stone wall by Baxter's brigade, losing about 800 men.

name: Heth attacks again
summary: Pettigrew and Brockenbrough cross Willoughby Run against Meredith, Biddle and Stone. The sources give 2:00, 2:30 and 3:00; the map shows the Union line here until 3 p.m.

name: Early strikes
summary: Gordon's brigade hits the knoll on Rock Creek that anchors the Eleventh Corps's right. The map times Gordon's line 3 p.m.; a modern timeline says 3:30.

name: McPherson Ridge lost
summary: Stone gives up the McPherson farm as Daniel and Davis close on it, and Doles drives in the Eleventh Corps's left.

name: North of town breaks
summary: Hays and Avery sweep past Coster's brigade at the brickyard and the Eleventh Corps falls back into the streets.

name: Seminary Ridge
summary: Pender's brigades attack the last First Corps line, behind a rail barricade at the seminary. About now Lee orders a general assault and Howard orders both corps back to Cemetery Hill.

name: Cemetery Hill
summary: The two corps rally on Cemetery Hill around Steinwehr's division as Hancock arrives and sends the First Corps to Culp's Hill. At 4:45 Lee tells Ewell to take the hill if practicable; Ewell does not attack.

name: The evening line
summary: The Union line runs from Culp's Hill, where Wadsworth's division digs in, over East Cemetery Hill and the cemetery to the head of Cemetery Ridge. Ewell does not attack the hill. Rodes holds the town, Early its eastern edge, Pender Seminary Ridge.

name: The town taken
summary: About 5 p.m. men of Perrin's 1st South Carolina raise their flag in the town square. The Confederates hold Gettysburg.
